# `∘` — Compose / Bind

`f∘g Y` is `f(g Y)`.

```apl
-∘× ¯3             ⍝ 1
```

`X f∘g Y` is `X f(g Y)`.

```apl
10+∘-3             ⍝ 7
```

`A∘f` binds the left argument; `f∘A` binds the right. Bound functions are monadic.

```apl
(10∘-)3            ⍝ 7
(-∘10)3            ⍝ ¯7
```

See [Atop / Rank](rank.qmd) and [Over](over.qmd).
